rows.title: Local cell configuration controls the response
rows.conclusion: Micah / SAN earlier → Taining Zhang, Adam Goldstein, Michael Levin later: the 2023-04-24 SAN wording record precedes this 2023-12-15 target version on the partial correspondence below.
rows.shared_operation: A cell-local configuration determines which input leads to which response, rather than every decision being made by one central controller.
rows.plain_language: In both accounts, what a local unit does depends on how that unit is configured. A biological sensor and a sorting-array cell implement that idea differently.
rows.formal_relation: A specified role/subchain mapping, not a proved isomorphism, bisimulation, categorical equivalence or calibrated dependence probability.
rows.residual: SAN describes learned physical receptor configurations and thresholds. The sorting model uses fixed algorithms and integer-valued array elements. Local state-dependent response is the partial correspondence; learning rules, physical carriers and output behavior are not shown identical.
